notes.title: Game Updata 1.181
notes.notes:
New

1. Partial reinforcement options for the workshop: If there is a corresponding card, it will be enhanced for free.

2. The workshop added 5 pieces to strengthen the way of building cards.

3. Adding a nightmare difficulty is divided into 7 difficulty levels.

4. Add new achievements Three genre cards for each hero
  Customs General, Advanced 7, Nightmare 7 Get the corresponding apprentice, master, master achievement.
  The achievement is pure achievement and no reward.

optimization

1. Substantially reduce the second and third chapter monster attributes
  The second chapter is reduced from full attribute +2 to full attribute +1
  The second chapter is reduced from full attribute +5 to full attribute +3

2. Hualing Card The card fee will increase after obtaining some enhancement effects.

3. Balance some cards
  Strengthened: Big Apple, Flower Fairy, Snow Monster, Flame Fort X, Fireball
  Weakened: Skeleton Drake, Avengers, Apple Flying Bucket

4. Treasure adjustment
   Compass: The building card used Back to the card library.

5. Building Cards Buildings without attack Drag and drop are strips for quick and easy placement.

6. The font description of the minaret event is displayed larger.

7. Adjust the initial deck to make the difference even greater.

BUG

1. Control the attribute error BUG after the follow-up.

2. The level "flying together" "do not move" Hua Ling card The chance of getting special effects is not normal BUG.

3. Found that the card card library did not get the card reinforcement and fusion effect BUG.

Originally I wanted to change it to free, but steam didn't change it.

I am sorry for the changes that have affected the old users.
For the old users who bought before, contact me, I will give you the DLC Key for free.

notes.title: 1.17 UpData
notes.notes:
Need to start a new game
If you don't want to start, first finish the game and then update it.

1.17 Update
1. Add a new maze talent function
Each hero has three geniuses, each genius has an ultimate skill, can only be used once.
A maze quest has the greatest five talents, that is, the greatest addition of an ultimate skill.

2. Adding a single combat time status
3 minutes into the final moment, both sides attack and magic + 10
Five minutes later into the fatigue moment, both sides attack + 100 heroes do not improve.

3. The largest number of treasures is now 30.
4. Card legend will also show prompts.
5. Dragon attacks add special effects, and bats add special effects to their blood pool treasures.
6. Optimize some cards, checkpoints and treasures.
7. Some BUG have been modified.

notes.title: 1.16 UpData

2. New intensification effect, cost reduction, explosion and control.
3. Modify the entry threshold of the arena, kill a BOSS and then enter the arena after the end of the risk.

5. Accelerate the labyrinth rhythm and reduce the difficulty in disguise. The first chapter has only 10 layers, and the second chapter has 15 layers.
6. Modified some monster difficulty.
7. Modify the distance of the assault, and no longer directly protrude the face.
8. Incident of changing Foundation Card Flower was added.
9. The problem of modifying arena connection.
